title.en: Moto Maou-sama to Koisuru Hana ~Kazoku ni Suterareta Ma no Ouzoku ni Metoraremashita~
Nise Seijo da to Ikenie ni Saretara, Maou-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Akuma de Kore wa Koi janai!
Keiyakukon shita Aite ga Oni Saishoudeshitaga, Kono-do Saishou-shitsu Sennin Hosa-kan ni Ninmei sareta Jimi Bunkan (Hensouchuu) wa Watashidesu
Tensei Shitara Maou no Musume Ukkari Sai Kyo Mazoku wo Sukiru de Miryo Shichatte Ama Sugiru Dekiai kara Nigeraremasen!
Kusuri no Mamono no Kaiko Riyuu

title.ja-ro: Kanpeki Sugite Kawaige ga Nai to Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru

title.en: Toraware Hanahime no Shiawase na Gosan
Niehime no Konin - Migawari Oujo wa Teikoku de Saiai to naru
Suterare Hanayome no Saikon - Koori no Henkyou Haku wa Saiai o Chikau
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Irazu no Hime wa Jinrou no Kuni de Aisare Ouhi to naru!
Kamiyui Otome no Yomeiri - Mukae ni Kita Danna-sama to, Kamisama ni Otsukae shimasu.
Seijo no Ane desu ga, Naze ka Miwaku no Koushaku-sama ni Tsukaeru Koto ni narimashita
